title: Shihou-sashi-shachi-sen
guidance: Four beams frame into one post. The two x tenons stack below the two z tenons so none share the post's core, and a tapered 車知栓 through each tenon locks it. 建築用語集 shows the 車知栓 as the red member in its 四方差し figure, while warning that the through tenons leave a large lost section in the post.

usage: Four-way post connection locked with paired 車知栓 wedge keys - the configuration shown in 建築用語集's 四方差し figure, where the red member is the shachi-sen.
strengths: Paired wedge keys draw all four tenons tight and resist withdrawal.
Opposite tenons pass through the post and tie one another.
weaknesses: Same warning as 四方差し: passing tenons leave a large lost post section; metal reinforcement may be needed.
Four tenons and two keys must be set out at distinct levels.
